sections.heading: 1. The home three
lines: ① Bridge: lift hips, shoulders to knees, 8–10.
② Dead bug: lower opposite arm and leg, 8–10.
③ Clam: on your side, lift top knee, 10–12 each.

caption:
Momo can get her legs over her head, but her glutes are still napping. No reformer at home? A mat and ten minutes is enough to start.

Three moves to try: bridges for your glutes and back of the legs, dead bugs for control through your trunk, and side-lying clams for the side of your hips. Move slowly, breathe steadily and aim for smooth control rather than speed. One or two rounds, about three times a week, is a good start.

Recovering from injury or surgery, pregnant, or getting sharp or lingering pain? Check with us first so we can adjust the moves.

Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio can tailor these to you. Book online via the link in bio 🐱
